title: shard-plan-{session}.json
description: Step 6.b output. Mechanical sharding plan + screening prompt template. See apex-core.md step 6.b.

screening_prompt.description: Shared template with hypothesis injected verbatim

_meta.description: Telemetry produced by shard-findings.sh. The orchestrator reads ripgrep_poisoned to branch the 6.b AskUserQuestion contract (proceed-with-prompt-paths vs screen-deterministic-only).

findings_count.description: Total findings entries before any --min-confidence filter.

deterministic_count.description: Findings entries with at least one non-ripgrep layer (static-imports/ast-grep/lsp/framework).

ripgrep_only_count.description: Findings entries whose only layer is ripgrep.

ripgrep_poisoned.description: True when findings_count > 0 AND deterministic_count == 0 (ripgrep keyword fallback poisoned by generic words; gate routes to proceed-with-prompt-paths).

min_confidence.description: --min-confidence flag passed to shard-findings.sh (default low = no filter).
